target_customer: Radiology AI companies and hospital research teams that need labeled CT, MRI and X-ray datasets
problem: Training radiology AI needs high quality 2D and 3D labeled medical images, and general purpose annotation tools handle DICOM volumes poorly.
business_model: B2B SaaS annotation platform, enterprise subscription

founders.name: Derek Lukacs
education: University of Michigan, BS and MS Aerospace Engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page says he cofounded the University of Michigan team in the SpaceX Hyperloop pod competition.

founders.name: Shivam Sharma
founders.background_notes: Named CEO and cofounder by the 2022 seed coverage and by the YC page as Lukacs's cofounder. No background found in opened sources.

competitors.name: Encord
competitors.what: Computer vision data platform that released a DICOM and NIfTI annotation tool for CT, MRI and X-ray

technical_complexity.rationale: A browser based 3D DICOM viewer with segmentation tools, interpolation and review workflows is real engineering for a small team, but it builds on known web and imaging libraries.

defensibility.rationale: Customers store datasets and workflows in the tool, and audit trails for FDA validation add some lock in, but rivals such as Encord and MD.ai offer similar DICOM labeling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found in searches through 2026. Rivals kept shipping DICOM tools and RedBrick remained independent and active.

market_need_then: Radiology AI developers needed ground truth labels for imaging models and the company cited radiologist shortages and growing AI investment in healthcare as drivers in its YC description.

branding.domain_note: Uses redbrickai.com, not the exact redbrick.com.

identity.visual_style: Clean B2B product marketing with customer logo walls and testimonials from radiology AI firms

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. Sector coverage mentions it only as a funded annotation vendor. The name is shared with unrelated companies named Redbrick.

outcome_analysis: RedBrick AI joined YC in Winter 2022 and raised a 4.6 million dollar seed in November 2022 led by Sequoia India's Surge, with early customers in radiology AI and hospitals. It remains active with a customer logo wall of radiology AI firms. No later round was found, so the stage after seed is unknown rather than absent. Competition from Encord and others in DICOM labeling is the main ongoing risk.
notes: Encord DICOM tool launch date was not visible in the search result so source_date is null; it may postdate the batch. Several outlets (YourStory, Inc42, Entrackr, Business Insider India) reported the 4.6M seed; one directory snippet says about 5.1M, treated as unverified. Founder education and employers for Sharma not found. No Series A search hit found.
